# BigQuery TIME_ADD/TIME_SUB wrap within a 24-hour day for all five supported parts.
# Expected times follow third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/time_functions.md
# and #time_sub, using integer arithmetic modulo the microseconds in a day.
# Read inputs from UNNEST to exercise translation rather than constant folding.

SELECT CAST(TIME_ADD(t, INTERVAL n HOUR) AS STRING) FROM UNNEST([TIME '01:02:03.456789']) t CROSS JOIN UNNEST([-9223372036854775808]) n
=> "17:02:03.456789"

SELECT CAST(TIME_ADD(t, INTERVAL n HOUR) AS STRING) FROM UNNEST([TIME '01:02:03.456789']) t CROSS JOIN UNNEST([9223372036854775807]) n
=> "08:02:03.456789"

SELECT CAST(TIME_ADD(t, INTERVAL n MINUTE) AS STRING) FROM UNNEST([TIME '01:02:03.456789']) t CROSS JOIN UNNEST([-9223372036854775808]) n
=> "06:54:03.456789"

SELECT CAST(TIME_ADD(t, INTERVAL n MINUTE) AS STRING) FROM UNNEST([TIME '01:02:03.456789']) t CROSS JOIN UNNEST([9223372036854775807]) n
=> "19:09:03.456789"

SELECT CAST(TIME_ADD(t, INTERVAL n SECOND) AS STRING) FROM UNNEST([TIME '01:02:03.456789']) t CROSS JOIN UNNEST([-9223372036854775808]) n
=> "09:31:55.456789"

SELECT CAST(TIME_ADD(t, INTERVAL n SECOND) AS STRING) FROM UNNEST([TIME '01:02:03.456789']) t CROSS JOIN UNNEST([9223372036854775807]) n
=> "16:32:10.456789"

SELECT CAST(TIME_ADD(t, INTERVAL n MILLISECOND) AS STRING) FROM UNNEST([TIME '01:02:03.456789']) t CROSS JOIN UNNEST([-9223372036854775808]) n
=> "17:49:07.648789"

SELECT CAST(TIME_ADD(t, INTERVAL n MILLISECOND) AS STRING) FROM UNNEST([TIME '01:02:03.456789']) t CROSS JOIN UNNEST([9223372036854775807]) n
=> "08:14:59.263789"

SELECT CAST(TIME_ADD(t, INTERVAL n MICROSECOND) AS STRING) FROM UNNEST([TIME '01:02:03.456789']) t CROSS JOIN UNNEST([-9223372036854775808]) n
=> "21:01:08.680981"

SELECT CAST(TIME_ADD(t, INTERVAL n MICROSECOND) AS STRING) FROM UNNEST([TIME '01:02:03.456789']) t CROSS JOIN UNNEST([9223372036854775807]) n
=> "05:02:58.232596"

SELECT TIME_ADD(t, INTERVAL n HOUR) FROM UNNEST([CAST(NULL AS TIME)]) t CROSS JOIN UNNEST([1]) n
=> null

SELECT TIME_ADD(t, INTERVAL n HOUR) FROM UNNEST([TIME '12:00:00']) t CROSS JOIN UNNEST([CAST(NULL AS INT64)]) n
=> null

SELECT CAST(TIME_SUB(t, INTERVAL n HOUR) AS STRING) FROM UNNEST([TIME '01:02:03.456789']) t CROSS JOIN UNNEST([-9223372036854775808]) n
=> "09:02:03.456789"

SELECT CAST(TIME_SUB(t, INTERVAL n HOUR) AS STRING) FROM UNNEST([TIME '01:02:03.456789']) t CROSS JOIN UNNEST([9223372036854775807]) n
=> "18:02:03.456789"

SELECT CAST(TIME_SUB(t, INTERVAL n MINUTE) AS STRING) FROM UNNEST([TIME '01:02:03.456789']) t CROSS JOIN UNNEST([-9223372036854775808]) n
=> "19:10:03.456789"

SELECT CAST(TIME_SUB(t, INTERVAL n MINUTE) AS STRING) FROM UNNEST([TIME '01:02:03.456789']) t CROSS JOIN UNNEST([9223372036854775807]) n
=> "06:55:03.456789"

SELECT CAST(TIME_SUB(t, INTERVAL n SECOND) AS STRING) FROM UNNEST([TIME '01:02:03.456789']) t CROSS JOIN UNNEST([-9223372036854775808]) n
=> "16:32:11.456789"

SELECT CAST(TIME_SUB(t, INTERVAL n SECOND) AS STRING) FROM UNNEST([TIME '01:02:03.456789']) t CROSS JOIN UNNEST([9223372036854775807]) n
=> "09:31:56.456789"

SELECT CAST(TIME_SUB(t, INTERVAL n MILLISECOND) AS STRING) FROM UNNEST([TIME '01:02:03.456789']) t CROSS JOIN UNNEST([-9223372036854775808]) n
=> "08:14:59.264789"

SELECT CAST(TIME_SUB(t, INTERVAL n MILLISECOND) AS STRING) FROM UNNEST([TIME '01:02:03.456789']) t CROSS JOIN UNNEST([9223372036854775807]) n
=> "17:49:07.649789"

SELECT CAST(TIME_SUB(t, INTERVAL n MICROSECOND) AS STRING) FROM UNNEST([TIME '01:02:03.456789']) t CROSS JOIN UNNEST([-9223372036854775808]) n
=> "05:02:58.232597"

SELECT CAST(TIME_SUB(t, INTERVAL n MICROSECOND) AS STRING) FROM UNNEST([TIME '01:02:03.456789']) t CROSS JOIN UNNEST([9223372036854775807]) n
=> "21:01:08.680982"

SELECT TIME_SUB(t, INTERVAL n HOUR) FROM UNNEST([CAST(NULL AS TIME)]) t CROSS JOIN UNNEST([1]) n
=> null

SELECT TIME_SUB(t, INTERVAL n HOUR) FROM UNNEST([TIME '12:00:00']) t CROSS JOIN UNNEST([CAST(NULL AS INT64)]) n
=> null
